summary: New box Preterit-wa: example for sense 1 in Preterit-wa (JTM 3.1/21)

data.turoyo: L əḏʕinawo lo miṯe na w lo saġ na, ruḥan zila, tayəmowa i ruḥo, ruḥo, lə zayʕinawo ... <...>
data.translation: Wir wussten nicht, ob wir tot oder lebendig waren. Unsere Lebenskraft war dahin! Die Lebenskraft war zu Ende, wir fürchteten uns nicht. <...>

rationale: First provisionally filed Preterit-wa example, zayʕinawo; explicitly flagged for paradigm confirmation.

summary: New box Preterit-wa: example for sense 1 in Preterit-wa (Lahdo Traitor 1/67)

data.turoyo: W kətwa hiye mu ʕamayḏan sti, kətwa hən yaʕni zayʕiwa, d əmmina, d Ṣṭanbəl, am mardnoye, ġalabe, ġalabe zayʕiwa, mərre: "Dʕar eba." <...>
data.translation: And of course there were among our people those who were scared, for example those living in Istanbul, the Merdellis. They were very, very scared and asked me to deny what I stated. <...>

rationale: Provisional Preterit-wa cell: repeated plural zayʕiwa in one short context; not counted as a verified paradigm discovery.

summary: New box ko-Preterit: example for sense 1 in ko-Preterit (MAC NE Mor Barsaumo/17)

data.turoyo: <...> Laqi lnahro dmaye, nahro kobe pelat, maye semoqe. Kozayəʕ̥, mdayšalle lu+baxyo, yatu, mdayšalle lu+baxyo. Lo+maǧrele moḥe bayn am+mayanək, naʕímowa.
data.translation: <...> He encountered a river, the river has waves, reddish water. He had become scared, he started crying, he sat down, he started crying. He didn’t dare plunge into that water, he was a child.

rationale: First ko-Preterit example: ko- with a-vowel qaṭəl base contrasts glossary zoyəʕ; dialectal vowel alternative remains a question.

summary: New box Part act.: example for sense 1 in Part act. (96/139)

data.turoyo: Omər: "L ḥəmyoni mə mawṣelelan?" Omər: "De, azza i ruḥayḏux w d ḥəmyonux! Ḥəmyonux ste bažari yo, zayoʕo yo."
data.translation: Was hat uns mein Schwiegervater eingeschärft? - Ihr seid wohl schon vor Angst gestorben, du und dein Schwiegervater? Dein Schwiegervater ist ein Städter, ein Angsthase! -

rationale: First Part act. evidence: dispositional zayoʕo yo, a fearful person, no new numbered sense for aspect alone.

summary: New box Part act.: example for sense 1 in Part act. (96/167)

data.turoyo: Ṣafrayto qayəm u ḥolo, omər: "Hə mayṯatwo maz zuḥṯe!" Omər: "Ašər, ḥolo, ono zayoʕo no." W lo məlle: "Səmli i namusayo."
data.translation: Am nächsten Morgen stand der Onkel auf und sprach: Nun, du warst ja wohl wieder am Sterben vor Angst! - Ach Onkel, ich bin eben ein Angsthase. - Er sagte aber nicht: Ich habe diese Heidentat getan.

rationale: New Part act. cell: explicit 1sg predication zayoʕo no corroborates the disposition adjective.

summary: New sense 2: (mit aʕl-) sich um jn ängstigen
rationale: The entry already quotes concern for someone at 76/108 with aʕl-, distinct from fear of a stimulus marked m-. Make the construction explicit and rekey the existing example, without adding a duplicate.

summary: New sense 1: (Detrans.) sich fürchten (unpersönlich)
rationale: Restore the missing sense list for the existing Detransitive Preterit example at 1/10; impersonal experiencer, m- stimulus.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (Lahdo Traitor 1/60)

data.turoyo: <...> Turkiya zayiʕo, d əmmat. Aṯən hani kulle li maḥkama aʕmi, i naqqa d azzi li maḥkama.
data.translation: <...> It was obvious that Turkey was afraid then. All these came to the court hearings with me! When I attended the hearings.

rationale: Unusual institutional experiencer and feminine finite form; the existing Preterit Intransitive cell already has four, so this adds participant/form evidence.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit Intransitive (67/45)

data.turoyo: La tre aḥunone əmmi mərre laḥ ḥoṯoṯaṯṯe: "Gali ḥoṯoṯo, hawullan a tfəngatayḏan, qəṭlina u šerano!" Hawi qunaqun zaʕ.
data.translation: Die beiden Brüder sprachen zu ihren Schwestern: "Schwestern, bringt uns unsere Gewehre, daß wir diesen Löwen töten!" Der Löwe wich zurück, er fürchtete sich.

rationale: Unusual reduced zaʕ; animal experiencer with overt preceding threat, beyond routine cell filling.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Hors 1/90)

data.turoyo: Leban ʕal an naʕimayḏan wa, ʕal am morayḏan wa w aḥna ze zayʕiwayna, dukṯo raḥəqto wa.
data.translation: Unser Herz war bei unseren Kindern, bei unseren Angehörigen, und wir hatten Angst, denn es war ja eine weite Reise (wörtl.: ein entfernter Ort).

rationale: Thin Infectum-wa cell: plural past fear in a distant-journey context, classification provisional.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JL 6.10/17)

data.turoyo: W i=kelikayo ḥa maṭ=ṭaye zoyaʕwa. Meqəm hama ġalabe maṭ=ṭaye lo=zayʕiwayna hafqa, hama hedi bi=ḥaraytaṯe zayʕiwayna ġalabe maṭ=ṭaye.
data.translation: Damals fürchtete man sich vor den Muslimen. Früher hatten wir uns nicht so sehr vor den Muslimen gefürchtet, doch dann in der letzten Zeit fürchteten wir uns sehr vor den Muslimen.

rationale: Thin Infectum-wa cell: earlier/later degree contrast and plural contracted forms; one quotation covers both tokens alongside the already quoted generic token.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (JTM 3.3/2)

data.turoyo: <...> W as səryoye uḏʕiwo gdowe aʕlayye mede lo kayiso, zayʕiwo, latwulle quwe ġalabe. <...>
data.translation: <...> Die orthodoxen Christen wussten, dass ihnen etwas Schlimmes zustoßen würde. Sie hatten Angst, weil sie nicht viel vermochten, <...>

rationale: Fills Infectum-wa to five: ongoing apprehension and following weakness explanation; preserve uncertainty about contracted past paradigm.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (JTM 1.6/6)

data.turoyo: <...> Omər: "Kubaʕno i kaččəkaṯe d msalmitulla. W d lə msalmitulla, u šuġlo gyoqər." Yaʕni mazəʕlelan. <...>
data.translation: <...> Er sagte: Ich möchte, dass ihr dieses Mädchen herausgebt, und wenn ihr sie nicht herausgebt, dann wird die Sache ernst. Er wollte uns Angst machen. <...>

rationale: Thin III Preterit cell: overt threat and first-plural experiencer object; edition's intention rendering retained.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (JTM 5.2/12)

data.turoyo: <...> omər alo mazəʕole, məlla tamam bas turitu u šarr nafəq. <...>
data.translation: <...> Er jagte ihr wirklich Angst ein. Da sagte sie: Genug, zerbrecht keine mehr, das Böse ist entwichen. <...>

rationale: Thin III Preterit cell: feminine experiencer suffix and resulting response.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (JTM 5.2/60)

data.turoyo: <...> komər axər, mqatqatlele kmo bənne, mazəʕile. <...>
data.translation: <...> Er erschlug einige von ihnen und jagte ihnen Angst ein. <...>

rationale: Thin III Preterit cell: plural opponent object; exact -ile spelling retained with a question.

summary: Fear-of stimulus normally uses m- (mu isan, mənne, maṭ=ṭaye); aʕl- in the existing 76/108 example instead marks concern for someone. This distinction is made explicit as I.2 without duplicating its quotation.
I qaṭəl can express onset or an enduring/resulting fear state. Reduced zaʕ/zāʕ occurs with human and animal experiencers.

Past contracted zayʕiwayna, zayʕiwo, zayʕinawo and zayʕiwa do not yield a secure paradigm boundary from spelling alone. Existing Infectum-wa parallels guide filing; the new Preterit-wa evidence remains explicitly provisional.
MAC NE Mor Barsaumo/17 Kozayəʕ̥ is provisionally ko-Preterit by a-vowel contrast with Infectum zoyəʕ. A dialectal vowel explanation remains possible.
III intimidation promotes the experiencer to object; the German modal wollte at JTM 1.6/6 is not a separate Turoyo want construction.
The existing Detransitive k-mizəʕ at 1/10 expresses impersonal fear with an m- stimulus, rather than a simple event affecting a fear patient. Its Preterit versus Infectum filing remains open.
Displayed original counts precede moving I Infectum example 2 to new sense 2. The original four other I.1 Infectum quotations remain; no routine fear example added.
Confirm contracted past-form boundaries: which zayʕ- forms are Infectum-wa, Preterit-wa or adjectival past predicates? Do not treat the provisional boxes as verified new paradigms.
Confirm ko-Preterit Kozayəʕ̥ versus dialectal Infectum vocalism at MAC NE Mor Barsaumo/17.
Does k-mizəʕ at 1/10 require Detransitive Infectum rather than the existing Detransitive Preterit heading?
Is zayoʕo a productive Part act. form or lexical disposition adjective? The quotations preserve it without inventing other forms.
Is zayiʕo after xud in JL 14.8/4 finite or a nominal/adverbial shock expression?
Confirm mazəʕile plural object at JTM 5.2/60, final ḥ in PrS 24/6 gzoyəḥ, and the apparently masculine zayʕat addressed to a woman at PrS 28/35.
Confirm alternate PrS/inherited references for the heart, hairy-body and snake-threat passages before replacing citations.
Experiencers include heart, eyes, animals and institutions. They remain fear participants, not separate lexical meanings.
zayoʕo predicates a fearful disposition. The trait/event contrast alone does not require another numbered sense.
